theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, liquid-motion dark mode interface prioritizing infinite canvas building, deep space aesthetics, and hyper-fluid drag-and-drop mechanics. It balances the structural rigor of a page builder with the smooth, organic transitions of a modern AI bot-driven app.

rules.headings: Tracking-tight, strictly non-Inter. Weights should be bold/black (700-900) for structural elements, medium (500) for card titles.
rules.body: Clean, highly legible geometric sans. Regular weight (400), loose line-height for chat and descriptions.
rules.labels: Uppercase, tracking-widest, text-xs. Used for system status and tiny metadata.

color_palette.rules: Never use pure #000000 or #808080. All grays must be tinted slightly cool (zinc). Gradients should be used sparingly as subtle background glows behind the canvas or AI chat panel, never as hard button backgrounds.

spacing_and_layout.general: High-density for the builder canvas, generous padding for the bot chat and configuration panels.

canvas_grid.behavior: Items must be draggable and resizable. Use fractional spans.

chat_panel.position: Fixed left or floating island on the left. Highly isolated from the canvas.

surfaces_and_materials.floating_toolbars: Glassmorphism: bg-zinc-950/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-2xl
surfaces_and_materials.canvas_cards: Solid dark surface (bg-zinc-900), 1px subtle border (border-white/5), no heavy shadow. On drag/hover: scale-up, z-50, shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)].
surfaces_and_materials.modals_and_edit_fields: Neumorphic inset/outset blend. Deep inset backgrounds for inputs (bg-black/50 border border-white/5).

animations.layout_transitions: All canvas items must have `layout` prop with a spring transition (stiffness: 300, damping: 30) for liquid resizing and reordering.
animations.liquid_hover: Subtle scale up (1.02) and color gradient shift on interactive elements.
animations.bot_typing: Staggered fade-in for chat messages, liquid expanding height using AnimatePresence.
animations.field_editing: When double-clicking a card field, morph the text into an input field seamlessly using `layoutId`.

component_instructions.shadcn_ui: Use shadcn/ui for Select, Dialog, Dropdown, Table, Tabs. Radix primitives should be styled with our deep dark theme.
component_instructions.builder_canvas: Custom HTML/Tailwind + Framer Motion. DO NOT use rigid Shadcn cards for the main canvas elements; build custom `motion.div` bento blocks so they can fluidly animate.
component_instructions.chat_interface: Use a sticky bottom input with blurred background. Messages should scroll behind it. Include a 'bot is thinking' animated SVG.
component_instructions.data_control: Each card must have a visible or hover-revealed toolbar (edit, duplicate, delete). Editing opens an inline or floating glass form.
component_instructions.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular) for a crisp, technical look.

canvas_background.usage: Use as a fixed background for the main building canvas with high opacity reduction (e.g., opacity-20) to give a liquid depth feel behind the bento grid.

avatar_bot.usage: Use as the avatar for the rrr bot in the chat interface.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react, and shadcn/ui base primitives.
Build a dual-panel layout: Left is the 'rrr bot' chat interface for commands, Right is the interactive liquid canvas.
The Right canvas must be a Bento grid where cards can be added, edited, and deleted dynamically. Use framer-motion's `<Reorder.Group>` or manual `layout` animations so changes flow like liquid.
Allow inline editing of text/fields inside the bento cards. Double click a text node to swap it with an input field.
Implement a 'bot-driven editing' flow: typing 'add a pricing card' in the chat should inject a new animated block into the bento grid.
Never use generic sans-serif for headings; use Outfit from Google Fonts.
Ensure the entire UI feels fluid and reactive (Liquid animated UI), avoiding abrupt DOM jumps.
Ensure dark mode is locked in as the default theme.
